_help: Generated by tools/gen_tree.ps1 (edit that, then run it). The ADVANCED tree (A-15): a second layer of the skill tree window. unlock.points = points a hero must have invested in the base tree before any advanced node can be taken; a path's gate also needs its base path's keystone OR unlock.armNodes nodes of that base path. Advanced nodes cost the same skill tree points (data/progression.json levelUp.tree per level). paths: advanced id -> name, base path (arm in data/skilltree.json), root = its gate node (ids here are local; the game adds the base tree's node count). Node types: gate, small, notable, key (capstone).

warlord.d: The Warrior who leads the line: heavier blows that sweep the whole fight.

champion.d: The Gladiator the crowd came for: crushing power attacks and finishers nothing interrupts.

juggernaut.d: The Berserker who cannot be stopped: fury that feeds on wounds.

kensei.d: The Samurai as sword saint: one perfect cut at a time.

dragoon.d: The Lancer who fights from the air: longer reach, higher leaps, harder landings.

grandmaster.d: The Monk at the end of the road: fists that need no weapon and a body that needs no armor.

sharpshooter.d: The Ranger who never misses: arrows that pass through everything in line.

pathfinder.d: The Wayfarer who has walked every road: nothing slows you and everything teaches you.

shadowblade.d: The Assassin become a shadow: killing crits, and a shade's shape to walk unseen.

fatespinner.d: The Fortune Seeker who bends luck itself: richer drops, luckier strikes, thinner armor.

doomcaller.d: The Warlock whose curses do not end: every affliction burns longer and deeper.

lichlord.d: The Necromancer past death: you drain the living, wear a wraith's shape, and healing barely reaches you.

timelord.d: The Chronomancer who owns the clock: everything of yours is ready sooner.

archmage.d: The Mage at full power: stronger spells, wider spells, and nothing between you and a blade.

sovereign.d: The Elementalist who rules all three: fire, frost and lightning as one, and little use for steel.

stormcaller.d: The Shaman the sky answers: lightning that leaps and leaps again, and a spirit of stone to wear.

archdruid.d: The Druid as the wild itself: deeper regrowth, stronger forms, and wings. Fire is your enemy.

beastlord.d: The Shapeshifter who would rather not change back: forms that last, hit hard and return fast.

maestro.d: The Bard at the height of the art: every song faster, wider and stronger.

highpriest.d: The Cleric as the voice of the light: the strongest healing there is, and no hand for weapons.

crusader.d: The Paladin on the march: judgement on every blow, behind a wall of faith.

runelord.d: The Spellblade whose sword is a spell: Magic pours into every swing.

ironclad.d: The Warden as a walking wall: nothing gets through, and nothing hurries you.
